title: BUG: InterpreterError: Forbidden function evaluation: 'open' is not among the explicitly allowed tools
author: arturoPMM

comments.author: suryabdev
comments.body:
Hi @arturoPMM, another workaround you could use is to pass in 'open' to the CodeAgent's executor_kwargs
```
agent = CodeAgent(executor_kwargs={'additional_functions':{'open': open}})
```
I've raised a PR https://github.com/huggingface/smolagents/pull/1832 to fix the issue, Will discuss with the others

comments.author: albertvillanova
comments.body:
This is the solution: use `additional_functions`: https://github.com/huggingface/smolagents/issues/1830#issuecomment-3442666336
```python
agent = CodeAgent(executor_kwargs={'additional_functions':{'open': open}})
```

Note that `open`:
- is a **function** and should be allowed with `additional_functions`. 
- is not a **module** that we could allow to be imported with `additional_authorized_imports`.
